text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seemingly relaxing her guard, Seeking the
Pearl finally tells me the
reason why she
ran sideways out of the gate in that
scrimmage.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
In a race, you never know what sudden
obstacle might spring up. For
example...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Drawing the outermost gate, getting
knocked down, starting
late—anything can
happen.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to consider every
possibility, and test each one for
myself. If
I do that, then I won't lose hope, no
matter what hurdle
might come my way.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...So her decision to run sideways was on
purpose.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I am a world-class pearl, no doubt about
it. But even I can't rely on
natural talent
alone to bring me across the finish line
every time.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she's neither difficult to work with, nor
prone to reckless behavior,
then Seeking
the Pearl has a bright future in racing.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even without accounting for all possible
hurdles, she could easily rack
up plenty of
accolades.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You're right. My talent alone could likely
lead me to greater heights.
In the past...
that guide entrusted me with a similar
dream.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Guide
text_block_list.text:
Little Umamusume, take a good look. This
is the palace, dear.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Guide
text_block_list.text:
If you want to live somewhere like here in
the future, then you have
to work hard,
okay? I know you can do it, dear.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
But that wasn't the only thing she said to
me.

text_block_list.name: Young Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Um, do you live somewhere like here right
now?

text_block_list.name: Experienced Guide
text_block_list.text:
Of course not... I rent a small room in the
slums. Hence, I enjoy tourist
spots like this.

text_block_list.name: Experienced Guide
text_block_list.text:
For folks like us, all we can do is dream.
But you, little miss, have
plenty of chances
in your future. So I wish you the best—for
our sakes,
as well.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
She entrusted me with her dream... but my
aspirations were, and are,
different. I don't
need a magnificent mansion to live in.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Haha, isn't it obvious?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I want to put the light back into the eyes
of those around the world
who've given up
on their dreams!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And I'm not just referring to that guide. In
the skyscraper slums of that
city, countless
people suffered every single day.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Or what about those born in places
without opportunity? Even if they
have
talent, they have no chance to show it off
to the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Our world is full of inequality. Those
blessed with talent and
opportunity win,
while everyone else is left in the dust.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And even if someone has everything going
for them, they'll still lose
to an opponent
born with even more talent. But a world
decided at
birth isn't fabulous in the
slightest, now is it?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I believe that even if our starts were
different, with enough hard work
and
dedication, anyone can make waves. That's
what I want to prove
with my running.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
We live in a big world—too big for simple
words of encouragement to
matter. But
even in a world like ours, there's
something that can
transcend words and
reach the hearts of everyone.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
...And that's races. In a race, we run,
compete, and aim for victory. It's
a simple
sport, one found all across the world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If I can achieve victory in spite of various
setbacks on a live
broadcast, then that'll
serve as my message to the entire world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
My running will connect the continents of
our planet! All six! Every
island! In a
fabulous rainbow of inspiration!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
And that is why I refuse to rely only on my
talent. Instead, I want to
continue
challenging the impossible. Did that help
clear things up?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the first time, I have a clear
understanding of Seeking the Pearl's

aspirations. She doesn't want to win for
herself...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to inspire hope throughout the
world. What makes her
amazing isn't just
her running prowess, but also the
motivation that
compels her to run.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Well then, I've shown you my world map.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now it's time for you to show me yours,
Trainer! What kind of dream
do you have
in mind for me?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
What I want to accomplish with Seeking
the Pearl... It isn't just about
reaching the
top of the racing world.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Possibilities..." You just said
"possibilities," did you not?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Good answer! No, perfect marks, Trainer!
In that case...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'll start off by showing you all my current
possibilities—everything I
can do as of this
moment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Pearl challenges Taiki Shuttle to a
rematch. They'll be
running 1,200 meters
on turf. The skies are clear, and the track
is in
good condition.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa, Pearl?! Your vibe's totally
changed from last time! Talk
about fast!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, wonderful—fabulous even, Taiki!
Your running's always the
same, rain or
shine. In mile races you're definitely the
strongest. But!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
(The conditions aren't always the same. In
this world, nobody ever
knows what'll
happen next. And in that world...)

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There exists a brilliant pearl that'll turn
yesterday's defeat into a
brand-new
possibility! I've got your rhythm down!
Hyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, no!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Whoooooa!)

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Wh-whoa, looks like Seeking the Pearl's
still got it! I thought she'd be
difficult to
work with, but today I can sense her fire
for victory!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should go scout her... I'll be right
back...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! ♪ To possibility and beyond!
Beauty calls!

text_block_list.name: Skilled Trainer A
text_block_list.text: H-hey! Where are you going?! Wait up!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After Seeking the Pearl's convincing win,
she's mobbed by trainers
looking to scout
her. This time, however, she flies away
from the
scene.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Some time later, at the summer festival...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, the trainer over there! How about an
accessory? Hm-hm... ♪

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Can't you see? I'm running an accessory
shop. My daddy deals with
precious
metals, and showcasing extraordinary
jewelry is our family's
calling.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Now, what are you looking for today? In
my professional opinion, to
really make
your life shine brightly...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You should choose either this golden pearl
or this silver pearl. Which
one will it be?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a cursory glance at the accessories
on the table, but my mind's
long been
made up.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, great choice! We have a keen
customer on our hands! Then
let's make
this pairing official.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hey, I bet I know what you're thinking
right now. "I found myself the
best pearl
out there," right?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I give her my honest thoughts. Hearing my
reply, Seeking the Pearl
shows me a
playful smile.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Haha, unfortunately, you're slightly
mistaken. You didn't find a pearl.
What
you found...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Was me. A girl who'd been seeking a pearl
named you.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
You are the pearl that will help me
shine—the only one in the whole
wide
world.
